characters.name: Shen
characters.lockedDescription: Shen, an adult male celebrated Heavenly Hero aged thirty, long straight black hair under a narrow silver crown, immaculate white silk swordsman robes with a silver cloud clasp, a straight silver jian in his right hand, clean-shaven angular face, imperious upright posture; his white right cuff stays blood-stained after the first sword strike.

characters.name: Lan
characters.lockedDescription: Lan, an adult female celebrated Heavenly Hero aged thirty, long black hair in a high crown bun with one silver pin, ivory silk fighting robes and a narrow dark blue sash, a sheathed straight sword at her left hip, composed oval face and an exacting level gaze; her movements are economical and grounded.

characters.name: Wen
characters.lockedDescription: Wen, an adult city woman aged twenty-eight, black hair in a plain low knot, faded pale-green travel robe with a repaired right sleeve, red city-citizen cord worn loose at her wrist, unbound hands, steady direct gaze; she stands and moves freely and is never chained, gagged or held.

characters.name: Rook
characters.lockedDescription: Rook, an adult male outcast aged fifty with a pronounced twisted upper back, one high shoulder, a lined watchful face, worn charcoal hemp layers and three heavy iron rings on a cord at his left wrist; he is physically powerful, moves with practiced balance and uses his right hand to turn one ring.

characters.name: Reed
characters.lockedDescription: Reed, an adult female outcast aged forty, healed left-arm amputation above the elbow, a scar across her left cheek, dark russet patched hemp coat, a bone thread spindle held in her right hand; she routes taut black thread through a wooden belt guide and never grows a replacement arm.

characters.name: Bell
characters.lockedDescription: Bell, an adult male outcast aged sixty with opaque blind eyes, scarred eyelids, a shaved head, worn smoke-grey hemp robe and a small bronze handbell; he orients his head toward sound, counts footsteps by listening and never tracks an opponent visually.

characters.name: Ash
characters.lockedDescription: Ash, an adult male outcast aged thirty-five with a visibly healed fused jaw and asymmetrical lower face, loose black hair, faded brown patched coat and a narrow bone flute; he invited Wen to cross the boundary at her request, his damaged jaw does not open normally and he never mouths dialogue.

characters.name: Heel
characters.lockedDescription: Heel, an adult male outcast aged forty with a pronounced right club foot, broad face, frayed ochre wrap coat and a small hide frame drum at his belt; he plants his adapted right foot before shifting weight onto his sound left leg, never sliding or changing his impairment.

characters.name: Red Squadron
characters.lockedDescription: The dead Red Squadron: adult soldiers in ruined dark-red lamellar armour, black helmets with short red tassels, blood-blackened cloth and pale corpse faces. They were killed by the Indigo Squadron before this story. Old spear wounds remain visible; black control thread knots at their wrists. Never living bandits, never Qing hopping vampires.

characters.name: Indigo Squadron
characters.lockedDescription: The dead Indigo Squadron: adult soldiers in broken indigo lamellar armour, black helmets with short blue tassels, blood-blackened cloth and pale corpse faces. They were killed by the Red Squadron before this story. Old sword wounds remain visible; black control thread knots at their wrists. Armour colours never swap.
